records.title: One Thousand and One Nights
records.corpus_boundary: BnF arabe 3609–3611 only: 281 medieval nights; exclude later Galland additions and Bulaq accretions.

original_route.candidate: BnF manuscript images; diplomatic Arabic transcription not located.

records.title: Devisement du monde
records.corpus_boundary: Collaborative multilingual tradition, not a single recoverable authorial text; BnF français 1116 is the preferred witness.

original_route.candidate: BnF français 1116 images, followed by a verified Franco-Italian transcription.

english_route.candidate: Yule–Cordier 1903/1920 complete edition at Project Gutenberg; not equivalent to français 1116.

findings.proposition: BnF dates the work to 1299, names Rustichello, identifies français 1116, and records 143 manuscripts.
Project Gutenberg identifies the complete Yule–Cordier 1903/1920 lineage.
